5880.title: Connect transport continuity after tunnel loss
5880.rootCauseOneLine: Spontaneous idle-drop cause is unknown; injected tunnel loss or replacement closes established visitor sockets via TunnelDO.abandonStreams.
5880.proposedFix: Correlate stored edge telemetry and reproduce on authenticated staging before changing behavior; stream continuation needs a lifecycle design rather than a speculative local patch.
5880.caveats: Second clean run by the same agent. Fault-injected workerd transport only, not macOS/ATL or multi-day stability. No phone auth/session failure reproduced. Reproduction sources and output are inline because the reports repository forbids publishing raw artifacts.
